341:t_2:71.en:
$n
「...Now we just have to do it.」

341:t_2:72.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Your timing was perfect, $n. Your drive changed the mood.」

341:t_2:73.en:
$n
「I've relied entirely on everyone until now. I just repaid a little of that.」

341:t_2:74.en:
$$クロウ$$
「I thought you had a delicate-looking face, but you've got a good smile.」

341:t_2:75.en:
$n
「That's because $$ランド$$ taught me how to smile.」

341:t_2:76.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And your piloting skills follow $$セツコ$$'s $$グローリー・スター$$ style, huh?」

341:t_2:78.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Of course I can. Believe it or not, I've made my living piloting machines.」

341:t_2:79.en:
$$デュオ$$
「What the hell are you saying!? You barely got to eat because you were paying off your debts!」

341:t_2:80.en:
$$トロワ$$
「Stop, $$デュオ$$. Sugar water is an important meal for $$クロウ$$ too.」

341:t_2:82.en:
$n
「Um... You've had a lot of trouble, haven't you? Mainly with money...」

341:t_2:83.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Thanks for being considerate. ...I'm not calling it a reward, but as a more experienced $$リアクター$$, I ought to give you something...」

341:t_2:84.en:
$$デュオ$$
「$n! If you're going to ask for something, make it anything but money!」

341:t_2:85.en:
$$カレン$$
「Even if you did ask, you wouldn't get a single G out of $$クロウ$$ if you shook him upside down!」

341:t_2:86.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Stay out of this, you guys!」

341:t_2:88.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No... It's fine. I'll give you something besides money. ...It's something I was taught when I enlisted.」

341:t_2:89.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...Frustration makes a man. Misery makes a man. Sorrow makes a man...」

341:t_2:91.en:
$$クロウ$$
「And only a mighty enemy will truly make you a great man... ...Those are the words of an ace from a past war.」

341:t_2:92.en:
$n
「You're the second person who's taught me those words.」

341:t_2:93.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...I messed up... I tried to give a young man some wise words, and someone beat me to it...」

341:t_2:94.en:
$n
「No... Thank you. Thanks to you... I've found the strength to keep living again.」

341:t_2:95.en:
$$クロウ$$
「By the way, who was the first?」

341:t_2:96.en:
$n
「It was my dad. He taught me survival skills, $$ジークンドー$$, and the strength to live.」

341:t_2:97.en:
$$クロウ$$
「$$ジークンドー$$, huh... So that's the basis for your machine's movements.」

341:t_2:98.en:
$$クロウ$$
「All right... Once things settle down, let's spar. You can face my $$システマ$$.」

341:t_2:99.en:
$n
「Dad said the $$人革連$$'s fitness exercises could never beat $$ジークンドー$$, a martial art for the whole person.」

341:t_2:100.en:
$$クロウ$$
「That's interesting... I might have to knock a cocky youngster down a peg.」

341:t_2:101.en:
$$スズネ$$
「What are you doing, $n and $$クロウ$$!? Everyone else is already preparing to launch!」

341:t_2:103.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly... You can say all the cool things you want, but they're worthless if you don't follow through.」

341:t_2:104.en:
$n
「I understand. ...$$クロウ$$... I'm looking forward to our match.」

341:t_2:105.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Yeah. But first, we've got to find a way home.」

341:t_2:106.en:
$$クロウ$$
(It seems we both have a weakness for beautiful older women with glasses, $n...)

341:t_2:107.en:
$$クロウ$$
(But $$ジークンドー$$, huh... Your dad... wanted to train your mind even more than your body...)

341:t_2:108.en:
$$クロウ$$
(I'll put my hopes in you. You're the one $$アドヴェント#pilot$$ entrusted his hopes to.)

341:t_3:3.en: ～$$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$　Hangar～

341:t_3:4.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Lieutenant $$ベルファンガン・クルーゾー$$, Master Sergeant $$メリッサ・マオ$$, Sergeant $$クルツ・ウェーバー$$...」

341:t_3:10.en:
$$テッサ$$
「I'm glad we have been reunited safely like this.」

341:t_3:11.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「We feel the same, Captain.」

341:t_3:13.en:
$$テッサ$$
「$$ミスリル$$'s major facilities, including $$メリダ島$$, were destroyed in attacks by $$アマルガム$$ in collusion with $$サイデリアル$$.」

341:t_3:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「After escaping $$メリダ島$$, we broke through the enemy encirclement in the $$デ・ダナン$$ and have been on the run ever since.」

341:t_3:15.en:
$$マオ$$
「Then you were caught in a $$時空震動$$.」

341:t_3:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Yes... Now that we have a prospect of returning to Earth, it has effectively saved us from a hopeless crisis.」

341:t_3:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「That's thanks to that $$烙印$$ thing $$ロジャー$$ talked about.」

341:t_3:18.en:
$$宗介$$
「I have no intention of thanking something so uncertain.」

341:t_3:19.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...I'm relieved, Sergeant $$相良$$, that having $$千鳥かなめ$$ taken from you has not robbed you of your will to fight.」

341:t_3:20.en:
$$宗介$$
「Yes...! I have no intention of giving up.」

341:t_3:21.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Then I have another sad report for you.」

341:t_3:22.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Major $$アンドレイ・セルゲイヴィッチ・カリーニン$$ was declared MIA in the battle on $$メリダ島$$.」

341:t_3:24.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Please have Lieutenant Colonel $$マデューカス$$ brief you on the battle on $$メリダ島$$ and what happened afterward.」

341:t_3:25.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「I understand. ...Everyone, we'll begin the briefing now.」

341:t_3:26.en:
$$宗介$$
「My apologies, Lieutenant. Before that, I would like to visit $n.」

341:t_3:27.en:
$$クルツ$$
「He's... been unconscious ever since we were transported to $$火星$$.」

341:t_3:28.en:
$$宗介$$
「And his $$血塗られた眼$$ have appeared again.」

341:t_3:29.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「...Very well. We'll proceed with the briefing without you, Sergeant. Report $l's condition to me afterward.」

341:t_3:32.en:
$$マオ$$
「Are you sure, $$テッサ$$? I'm not saying it's your chance or anything, but don't you want to talk to $$宗介$$ more?」

341:t_3:33.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...Before, when the $$デ・ダナン$$ split off from us, $$相良$$ turned me down.」

341:t_3:35.en:
$$テッサ$$
「But I'm all right. I'm the captain of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and one of $$ミスリル$$'s few survivors.」

341:t_3:36.en:
$$テッサ$$
「So... I'm all right... I have... so many things... I have to do...」

341:t_3:37.en:
$$マオ$$
「...$$テッサ$$... You're definitely going to be a fine woman.」

341:t_3:38.en:
$$テッサ$$
「Oh? You make it sound as if I'm not one now.」

341:t_3:39.en:
$$マオ$$
「...Let's make it back to Earth, $$テッサ$$. And after we blow away $$アマルガム$$, $$サイデリアル$$, and $$バアル$$, then...」

341:t_3:41.en:
$$マオ$$
「Let's laugh from the bottom of our hearts! We'll throw everything aside!」
